_note: Statuses a skill can leave on an enemy (design/05 Appendix B, approved by Brent 2026-10-12). All of it is ours [MODEL]. Each: max stacks, how long it lasts (refreshed when applied again), and the numbers its rule reads. soaked: shoves on the target go shove_mult as far, and it conducts lightning (cross rule 1: a lightning hit on a soaked target puts conduct_marks on every other soaked enemy within conduct_radius). live: lightning's marks; at max stacks the target Overloads - overload_damage to it, stunned for stun seconds, arc_damage to every other marked enemy within arc_radius, and the caster's lightning reflux drops by grounds. stunned: cannot move or act. staggered: poise broken - cannot act, takes damage_taken_mult, and a bare strike on it is an Opening (balance.combat.opening_mult).
